questions.question: Can you confirm the exact street address for the north DC pickup location?
What temperature setting does this load need (frozen, refrigerated, or dry)?

why: The customer only ever refers to the pickup as 'the north DC', never giving a street address, so origin city/state/zip are left null with a question asking for the exact address; the company name itself is kept as stated. Two possible ready dates (9/30 or 10/1) are given, so the earliest, 9/30, becomes ready_date and pickup is flagged to be scheduled rather than asked about. No delivery date is ever mentioned, so DELIVERY_TO_BE_SCHEDULED is set with no question. The pallet/case/weight figures are corrected in the final reply (12 pallets/480 cases/9,600 lbs), so only the corrected numbers are kept, matching the per-case weight ratio from the original. The customer explicitly accepts the broker's quoted $975 rate in the last message, so that becomes rate_usd instead of triggering RATE_LOOKUP_NEEDED. No temperature is mentioned anywhere in the thread, so temp fields are left null with a question rather than defaulting to a standard range, since no mode word was given at all.

questions.question: What date will the freight be ready for pickup at the north DC?

why: Customer gives a PO, pallet/case/weight counts, and names the pickup only as 'the north DC' with no street address — that's treated as sufficient identification rather than a missing field, so no address question is raised. No date of any kind is given, so ready_date is left null with a question about when the freight will be ready (never phrased as a pickup-date ask), and both PICKUP_TO_BE_SCHEDULED and DELIVERY_TO_BE_SCHEDULED are flagged since no delivery date was discussed either. Temperature is given only as 'frozen' with no setpoint, so the standard -10 to 0 range is applied with TEMP_STANDARD_ASSUMED. The broker quoted $2150 and the customer explicitly accepted it ('works for us, go ahead and book it'), so that becomes the entered rate rather than triggering RATE_LOOKUP_NEEDED.

questions.question: What's the pickup address for 'our usual dock'?

why: The pickup is named only as a recurring nickname ('our usual dock, same place as last time') with zero address detail anywhere in the thread or attachment, so origin is left fully empty and a single question asks for the location.
